claim: A w:numId of 0 names no numbering definition: it switches numbering off, and on a style it cancels the numbering the style would otherwise inherit through w:basedOn.

sources.locator: wml.xsd simpleType ST_DecimalNumber restricts xs:integer with no facet, so 0 is an ordinary value to the schema
Part 1 17.9.18 numId, 17.9.19 numPr (clause cited by the repository, not verified against the archive)

fixtures.assertion: The style resolves to no numbering, and a round trip keeps <w:numId w:val="0"/> rather than dropping w:numPr.
